name: Stecon Group Public Company Limited
summary: Stecon Group Public Company Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the engineering and construction, utilities and power, infrastructure related to logistics, transportation, and other businesses in Thailand. The company undertakes construction works, such as public utilities, building, energy, industrial, environmental construction, and other projects activities.
